name: Angelina Crown
original_name: アンジェリーナ・クラウン
source:
A beautiful girl who serves as [url=/c166986]Kureha[/url]'s personal butler, who is also her childhood friend. Angelina was born into a family of butlers and as a result, has always worked as a butler instead of being a maid. Because she has known Kureha for so long, Angelina easily gets carried away when she's around rich girls. Ever since she started working at the Takamiya family's mansion, she has been at the whims of her boarish lady and the haughty guy who keeps hitting on her.

In private, she behaves like a "typical girl".

[From [url=https://asa-pro.com/ousama/character/]official website[/url]]
